plan: Built directly off the room's own crack line. Ground pressure from two directions: Mega Garchomp's Earthquake (and Garchomp is itself Ground/Dragon, so Pincurchin's terrain-boosted Electric attacks do nothing to it) and Landorus' single-target Earth Power, which lets me hit a Ground target without damaging my own partner. Incineroar supplies Fire for Aegislash and Magearna and Knock Off for Terrain Extender and Life Orb, and is my test of the plan's claim that Electric Terrain blocks priority. Urshifu's Close Combat is the Fighting half of the Steel answer and Unseen Fist ignores both Protect and King's Shield. Flutter Mane outspeeds Surge Surfer Alolan Raichu even in terrain. Gholdengo's Good as Gold refuses Rotom-Mow's Will-O-Wisp outright.
